_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
A nyi azɔnwà {player_id} to LinesOfAction tɔn lɛ.
A wumɛnɔ wɛ ' {side} ', azɔnwà wumɛnɔ wɛ ' {other} '.
Gbɛjɛ kpodo: `[b1b3]` (gbɛ yi gbɔna). Gbɛjɛ dɔwɛ lɛ hɛnnu azɔn, kponnɔ, kpanɔnɔ kponnɔ azɔn wumɛnɔ (kpɔɖɛ wɛ) to gbɛ lɛ. A sɔ azɔn wumɛnɔ lɛ, gba a ma sɔ azɔnwà wumɛnɔ lɛ; a to azɔnwà gbɛ mɛ, a na ɖɔ azɔnwà. A wɛna wɛ a wumɛnɔ ɖokpo ɖɔ ɖɛnɛ kpɔkpɔ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: E ɖó na nyí e2e4 (tín,dé coordinates).
invalid_move.identical: Nǔ e sín fí è wá é kpo nǔ e yì wɛ è ɖè ɔ́ kpó nyí ɖokpo.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Hɔn ɔ ɖó na nyí ɖido alǒ diagonal.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: E ɖó na gló mɛ e ɖò zɔ nú xɛ lɛ é ɖokpo ɔ.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Kɛntɔ́ lɛ sín nǔ ɖò ali ɔ glɔ́n wɛ.
invalid_move.destination_own: Akpá e è sɔ́ dó mɔ tɛn na yì é wɛ nyí ɖɔ yeɖesunɔ tɔn.

game_action.captured_suffix: Abla {player_id} wɔ {from} -> {to} na ɖɛ wɔ gbɔ.

outcome.draw_no_capture: É yì afɔ 60 có è ka wlí ɖě ǎ.
outcome.draw_repetition: Nɔ tɛn ɔ mɛ azɔn atɔn.
